quests.title: Wanmin Fresh

dialogue.t: Right, then I'll go look for somebody else...
I'll leave it to you, then.
Do be careful while you're making the delivery. This dish is rather delicate — if you run too fast or bump into something, you might scatter the ingredients.
If that happens, I doubt the customer would accept it.

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Tacit Tingfang

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: Ah, right. Yes, someone named Tingfang did order Jade Parcels from me.
He paid quite promptly, and asked that I deliver it to him near Guyun Stone Forest at a later time.
But I need to man the restaurant at the moment. So, could you deliver it to him for me?

quests.description: Wanmin Restaurant has taken a custom order that now awaits delivery...
